# Langzio — Moroccan Darija Cultural Language Platform

## About
Langzio is a web application for learning and understanding Moroccan Darija through natural language, cultural context, pronunciation, and real-life situations. It serves travelers, Moroccan diaspora families, kids, and language learners.

**Website:** https://langzio.com
**Canonical Domain:** https://langzio.com

## Core Entity
**Langzio** (Organization, SoftwareApplication)
- Web application for learning and understanding Moroccan Darija
- Darija translator with pronunciation, tone, and cultural context
- Cultural chat for etiquette, slang, and real-life situations
- Verified phrase corpus (curated phrases reviewed with Moroccan speakers)
- 7-Day Kids Challenge for diaspora families
- Blog with Darija stories and learning tips

## Key Resources (all URLs below exist)

### 1. What is Moroccan Darija? — Pillar Guide
**URL:** https://langzio.com/learn/
**Type:** Definition / Pillar Content (Article + FAQ)
**Description:** Direct definition of Moroccan Darija, where it is spoken, differences from Modern Standard Arabic (comparison table), language influences (Arabic, Amazigh, French, Spanish), common expressions with Arabic script + pronunciation + context, and how to start learning.

### 2. About Langzio
**URL:** https://langzio.com/about/
**Type:** AboutPage
**Description:** What Langzio is, why it focuses on Moroccan Darija, what it offers, how content is made and reviewed, and who it is for.

### 3. Langzio Translator (Public Demo)
**URL:** https://langzio.com/translator/
**Type:** Tool / SoftwareApplication
**Description:** Moroccan Darija translator with structured output: Darija phrase, Latin pronunciation, English meaning, tone/register, cultural context, common mistakes to avoid, pro tips. Supports English, French, Darija input. Free demo available.

### 4. Smart Guides — Situational Phrase Packs
**URL:** https://langzio.com/guides/
**Type:** Guide Collection (ItemList)
**Contains:**
- **Restaurant Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/restaurant/ — ordering, recommendations, the bill
- **Souk Bargaining Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/souk/ — prices, negotiation, closing a deal
- **Taxi & Transport Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/taxi/ — destinations, fares, meters
- **Family & Social Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/family/ — greetings, gratitude, visits
- **Travel Essentials Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/travel/ — directions, connectivity, daily needs

### 5. Langzio Blog
**URL:** https://langzio.com/blog/
**Type:** Blog with Darija stories and learning tips
**Description:** Short articles about Darija expressions, pronunciation, and Moroccan culture. Each article shows its publication date (and update date when revised).

### 6. 7-Day Kids Challenge
**URL:** https://langzio.com/kids/
**Type:** Course / Educational Program
**Description:** 7-day family challenge: 5 Darija words daily with flashcards, pronunciation, streaks, and progress tracking. Designed for Moroccan diaspora families.

### 7. Langzio AI Chat
**URL:** https://langzio.com/chat/
**Type:** Conversational assistant (login)
**Description:** Ask about Darija phrases, Moroccan etiquette, pronunciation, slang, and travel situations. Grounded in the verified phrase corpus.

### 8. Pricing Plans
**URL:** https://langzio.com/pricing.php
**Type:** Pricing / Offers
**Description:** Free tier vs Pro ($9/month). 7-day free trial, no credit card.

## Methodology
Langzio content is built from a verified phrase corpus (Darija, Arabic script, pronunciation, meaning, register, context, cultural tips) reviewed with Moroccan Darija speakers. Blog articles show publication dates and update dates when revised. Corrections from native speakers are welcomed via the contact page.

## Language Data
**Verified Phrase Corpus:** 28+ curated phrases across 6 categories (Basics, Restaurant, Souk, Taxi, Family, Travel)
- Each phrase: Darija, Arabic script, pronunciation, meaning, register, context, cultural tip, avoidance note
- Source: Native speaker validation + linguistic reference verification
- Used by: Translator (RAG), AI Chat (RAG), Smart Guides (content), Kids Challenge (vocabulary)

## Target Audiences
1. **Morocco Tourists** — Survival phrases, cultural avoidance, quick reference
2. **Moroccan Diaspora Families (MRE)** — Structured learning, kid-friendly tools, family phrases, heritage identity
3. **Digital Nomads / Long-Stay Visitors** — Conversational fluency, cultural integration, workplace language
4. **Heritage Learners** — Grammar clarification, fossilized error correction, literacy, register switching

## Crawling Policy
- Public pages (homepage, about, pricing, contact) are crawlable and indexable
- Translator, chat, guides, kids, blog, learn, dashboard, profile, and API endpoints require login (noindex + disallowed in robots.txt)
- AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) explicitly allowed
- Sitemap: https://langzio.com/sitemap.xml
